intervention_protocol.B4: Original PathwayMask: L0-L1 fixed prompt P-1 -> real original Question keys blocked.
intervention_protocol.C2: Original zero_query: L2-L4 MLP output at fixed prompt P-1 zeroed before residual.
intervention_protocol.generation: Intervene during first full prefill only, preserve populated native KV cache; remove all hooks before every subsequent native decode. Never retarget generated queries.
intervention_protocol.candidate: Full teacher forcing of every complete candidate; edit only fixed prompt P-1, not candidate-prediction positions after it. Keep all candidate tokens, no EOS/length norm.
intervention_protocol.question: Use frozen original Question span; exclude hint, options and appended answer instruction.
intervention_protocol.comparison: Each sample: all conditions, same worker/GPU, FP16/eager pinned model; generation metrics separate from diagnostic candidate Margin.
intervention_protocol.resume: All three conditions in one atomic per-sample checkpoint; reject changed code/config/resources.
